Each accept-set or public-surface change the diff implies, read off the diff and the head tree, and named right or wrong.

1. **`AppHeader`'s `variant` prop accepts a fourth member, `'studio'`** (`@object-ui/app-shell`): the accept set of a published component prop widens. Right: it is the ruled Q1 → A. `AppHeaderVariant` is exported from the `AppHeader` module but not from the package entry — `exports` in the package's `package.json` is `.` and `./styles.css` only, and the entry re-exports `AppHeader` alone — so a host meets the union only as the prop's type, as the PR body says. The `app` / `home` / `orgs` branches are untouched; the other edits in the file are the union and three comments. Right.
3. **No search trigger on `/studio`**: the trigger is drawn under a `CommandPaletteProvider` only (objectui#11912's rule); `/studio` mounts none, and the 11912 test now runs the `studio` variant through its no-provider case. Right. Q2 (the palette outside app frames) is correctly left to a later round.
4. **`StudioLanding` mounts `AppHeader variant="studio"`** (`@object-ui/console`), in a `header` whose class string is byte-equal to the one `HomeLayout` and `OrganizationsLayout` wrap their `AppHeader` in. The brand is the header's logo link, `to={homePath}` from `useHomePath()`, so the landing and `StudioDesignSurface`'s Home button still name one home (objectui#7256 / #7373). `studioRoutes` sits under `ConsoleShell` (which mounts `NavigationProvider`) behind `ProtectedRoute`, the tree `/home` has, so the header meets no new provider gap — and `StudioRoute.test.tsx`, the landing i18n test and the lazy-builder test render it through the real route tree. Right. `StudioPackageBuilder` and the Q3 recent-package record are untouched.
5. **`@object-ui/i18n` widens**: `console.studio.title` ("Studio") in all ten packs, the row the crumb reads; the identity with `en` in zh / ja / ko / ru / ar is allowlisted in `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts` with its reason (a product name). Right: the retriage's "one crumb-label row in all ten packs". `check:i18n-keys` and the i18n suite are green in CI.
6. **`@object-ui/i18n` narrows**: `console.studio.backToHome` leaves all ten packs. The removal is right — the retriage ruled "`console.studio.backToHome` retires in the same PR" — and no reader remains at this head (`git grep` finds only the retired-key sentinel in `StudioRoute.landingI18n.test.tsx`, which pins that nothing on the landing asks for it, plus two CHANGELOG entries). The exported `en` pack and `TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`) lose one member. Its declaration is wrong — see ②.
7. **README**: the one place that lists the header's surfaces ("home / app / orgs") now names `studio`. Right. No guide under `content/docs/guide/` lists the variants (two `AppHeader` mentions, a tree diagram and the notifications table). Right.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/11863-studio-header.md`: `'@object-ui/app-shell': minor`, `'@object-ui/i18n': patch`, `'@object-ui/console': patch`. All three are released packages in the fixed group with changed source; `Changeset Declaration` (presence) and `Changeset Bump Policy` (no `major`) are green.

- `@object-ui/app-shell: minor` — right: a published prop's accept set widens, and the body names the widening and what an exhaustive host must do.
- `@object-ui/console: patch` — right: a frame of the app changes; no export.
- **`@object-ui/i18n: patch` — wrong.** The diff removes `console.studio.backToHome` from the exported `en` pack, so `TranslationKeys` loses a member: a narrowing of a published type. objectui's version policy (AGENTS.md §版本号策略: 「objectui 自身的破坏性变更也标 `minor`（在正文里写清 breaking 语义即可）」) puts a breaking change at `minor` with its semantics written in the body, and the two exact-shape precedents pending in the same directory do just that: `11674-shortcuts-dialog-wired-only.md` (seven unused `console.shortcuts.*` keys leave all ten packs → `'@object-ui/i18n': minor`, "Clause-②: no (narrowing)") and `11676-retire-overdue-key.md` (one key gone from all ten → `'@object-ui/i18n': minor`, a "Narrowed public surface (`@object-ui/i18n`)" paragraph naming `en` and `TranslationKeys`). Of the ten pending changesets that declare `'@object-ui/i18n': patch` at this head, none removes a key. This changeset's paragraph says the key "drops … which nothing reads any more" — true inside this repository, but it names no narrowed surface for a host. The fixed group ships at `minor` either way (the `app-shell` row drives it), so the version number is unaffected; the declaration is what is off, and no gate reads the level — this record is the only reader.
  **Remedy**: `'@object-ui/i18n': minor`, and one sentence in the i18n paragraph in the 11676 shape — the exported `en` pack and `TranslationKeys` lose `console.studio.backToHome`; a host that typed that key drops it.

`Clause-②:` line — `yes` in the PR body, "yes (widening)" in the changeset, `yes` in the claim: right, and consistent. The widening is the `variant` accept set. The i18n narrowing does not change the clause (a narrowing is not clause-② work, as 11674's "no (narrowing)" shows), but once the i18n row reads `minor` the changeset's bold line should also name the narrowing, as 11674 does.
